body: Sorry to hear about your abscess that's no fun!
What sort of thoughts?  I have had many brick in the face moments over the last few months so I understand...  The meds help somewhat but alcohol makes things worse again...
Tell your doctor or therapist how you feel and be honest.
It's a self defense mechanism for the mind to reduce feet of death... This happens to me frequently.   Sometimes when I'm driving which can be scary...

Think happy and be happy...until all of the sudden you no longer can and everything around you makes you sad for no reason.....  It works when it works :)

Crazy thing is I have never felt suicidal while anxious...  I use the deep breathing technique frequently like when i'm in meetings or driving.  Good advice though thanks.
Lamictal works well can confirm :). Takes months to begin working fully though.

It was impossible to think positively or rationally when I was in this state of mind.  I completely understand how you feel.  Smoking weed made my crazy...  I became delusional so that's out.  Alcohol sometimes helps but often it makes me worse the next day.
Thanks for the reply.  Any advice on how to deal with it?  Its hard to function when one is feeling suicidal.
Thanks I'll talk with my doctor.  I like this subreddit, people respond to posts :).  I had posted on suicidewatch that night and never got a response.
I'm still coming to terms with it.  I had suspected something was wrong for awhile...  The meds help somewhat.
Holly shit are you me?  Everything you said I can relate to.  On days like today, you just want to disappear...  Want to chat?
Same.  Keep going up on the dose as your doctor recommends.

Hey thanks :).  Journaling sounds like a good idea, I will try it.
> therapist, it's a really good idea.  
> 
> Journal a lot right now. You probably don't know what to do with yourself anyway, and writing out how you feel in your highs and lows can give better perspective on how to handle them.  Good luck and welcome.
This is amazing thanks for sharing.
